subject: Quarry Labs: bank verification & remittance mapping for vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@quarrylabs.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-30T09:12:00Z
Subject: Vendor onboarding: bank proof and remittance mapping request

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get Quarry Labs fully live. To complete vendor enrollment and ensure PO remittances route correctly, could you send the following items when convenient?

- A redacted bank statement showing account name and routing (if possible, last 4 digits visible) or a bank letter on letterhead
- Signed W-9 (or equivalent tax form)
- Your preferred remittance string (how you want POs and invoices labeled; e.g., PO#: ####, client reference)
- Point of contact for payment ops (name, email, phone)

If you prefer ACH, we’ll run micro-deposits from our test account within 48 hours of receiving the bank proof. Once those clear and you confirm amounts, finance will flip the vendor to live for regular runs.

Attachments: procurement_onboarding_checklist.pdf (stub)

Appreciate a reply with the files — copying Jonas (Finance) to speed the verification.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Vendor Programs Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0142

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: bank proof and remittance mapping request

Hi team —

Received the bank statement and W-9, thanks Elena. A couple of finance items before we flip Quarry to live:

1) Micro-deposit verification: we will initiate two small ACH deposits from Redwood Test Acct (Redwood, N.A.) within the next 24 hours. Please confirm amounts once they appear in your ledger (they will be understated, e.g., $0.12 / $0.37).

2) Remittance mapping: we need an explicit PO label mapping for automated reconciliation. Your suggested string looks fine, can you confirm whether you want the PO number in the format PO-12345 or 12345 (no prefix)? The parser treats hyphens differently for some ERPs.

3) Effective payment terms: please confirm Net 30 (default) or another term so invoicing rules apply correctly.

4) Attach a filled 'Vendor Enrollment - Bank + Remit' PDF and a contact for dispute handling.

Attachments: vendor_enrollment_form_fillable.pdf (please complete and return)

Once we confirm micro-deposits and get back the completed enrollment form, finance will mark the vendor as Active and schedule the first payment run.

Thanks —
Jonas Weber
Senior Manager, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming the micro-deposit amounts ($0.16 / $0.41). We’ve recorded Quarry Labs as Active in the vendor portal and set remittance parsing to expect PO numbers as plain digits (e.g., 12345). Payment terms are Net 30.

Thanks everyone — happy to close this once we’ve got the DocuSign packet in the portal.
